local scn, done = ...
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local start, ang = Vector(700, -600, -143.6), Angle(0, 90, 0)
local crate = ents.Create("prop_physics") crate:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
crate:SetPos(Vector(700, -400, -123.6)) crate:Spawn() crate:Activate()
local samples, events, t = {}, {}, -30
-- buttons, forward move, side move per tick
local function held(tk)
  if tk >= 10 and tk < 70 then return IN_FORWARD, 10000, 0 end
  if tk >= 80 and tk < 110 then return IN_BACK, -10000, 0 end
  if tk >= 120 and tk < 150 then return IN_MOVERIGHT, 0, 10000 end
  if tk >= 160 and tk < 190 then return IN_JUMP, 0, 0 end
  if tk >= 200 and tk < 230 then return IN_DUCK, 0, 0 end
  if tk >= 240 and tk < 270 then return IN_FORWARD, 10000, 0 end
  if tk >= 300 and tk < 330 then return bit.bor(IN_FORWARD, IN_SPEED), 10000, 0 end
  if tk >= 340 and tk < 342 then return IN_USE, 0, 0 end
  return 0, 0, 0
end
local function view(tk)
  if tk >= 240 and tk < 270 then return Angle(30, 180, 0) end
  return ang
end
for _, h in ipairs({ "PlayerStartDriving", "PlayerStopDriving", "StartDriving", "StopDriving" }) do
  hook.Add(h, "parity_drive", function(a, b, c) events[#events+1] = { t = t, hook = h, ent = IsValid(b) and b:GetClass() or tostring(b), mode = c } end)
end
hook.Add("StartCommand", "parity_drive", function(ply, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement()
  local b, fwd, side = held(t)
  cmd:SetButtons(b) cmd:SetForwardMove(fwd) cmd:SetSideMove(side)
  cmd:SetViewAngles(view(t))
end)
hook.Add("SetupMove", "parity_drive", function(ply, mv, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  if t < 0 then mv:SetOrigin(start) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0)) mv:SetButtons(0) end
end)
hook.Add("Think", "parity_drive", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == 0 then
    drive.PlayerStartDriving(bot, crate, "drive_sandbox")
    events[#events+1] = { t = t, call = "start", mass = crate:GetPhysicsObject():GetMass() }
  end
  if t == 350 and IsValid(bot:GetDrivingEntity()) then
    events[#events+1] = { t = t, call = "use_did_not_stop" } drive.PlayerStopDriving(bot)
  end
  if t >= -1 and t <= 360 then
    local phys = crate:GetPhysicsObject()
    local de = bot:GetDrivingEntity()
    samples[#samples+1] = { t = t, crate = crate:GetPos(), vel = phys:GetVelocity(), ang = crate:GetAngles(), angvel = phys:GetAngleVelocity(),
      asleep = phys:IsAsleep(), bot = bot:GetPos(), bvel = bot:GetVelocity(), eye = bot:EyePos(), eyeang = bot:EyeAngles(),
      mt = bot:GetMoveType(), driving = IsValid(de), mode = bot:GetDrivingMode(), obs = bot:GetObserverMode(),
      solid = bot:GetSolid(), vis = not bot:GetNoDraw(), viewent = IsValid(bot:GetViewEntity()) and bot:GetViewEntity():GetClass() or "",
      viewoff = bot:GetViewOffset(), cmt = crate:GetMoveType(), motion = phys:IsMotionEnabled(), evel = crate:GetVelocity(),
      parent = IsValid(crate:GetParent()) and crate:GetParent():GetClass() or "", target = IsValid(bot:GetObserverTarget()) and bot:GetObserverTarget():GetClass() or "",
      gravity = phys:IsGravityEnabled(), crate_vis = not crate:GetNoDraw(), bhp = bot:Health() }
  end
  if t == 361 then
    for _, h in ipairs({ "Think", "StartCommand", "SetupMove", "PlayerStartDriving", "PlayerStopDriving", "StartDriving", "StopDriving" }) do hook.Remove(h, "parity_drive") end
    done({ samples = samples, events = events, has_drive = drive ~= nil, modes = (function() local m = {} for k in pairs(drive.Modes or {}) do m[#m+1] = k end table.sort(m) return m end)() })
  end
end)
return "async"
